description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying its mana cost, copying Approach of the Second Sun and returning the original Approach of the Second Sun to your hand.
Resolve the Approach of the Second Sun copy, causing you to gain 7 life.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost, causing you to win the game.
